name: Thanksgiving new skins: Holly, Clone, Cloud and Harmony
picture_standard: This is a Thanksgiving outfit for a character in a kids' co-op escape game for ages 8 and up: friendly and cozy, never scary. For a FRONT view the attached picture is this SAME character's approved look: keep the face, skin tone, eyes, hair, body shape and proportions exactly the same - change ONLY the clothes and accessories as described. For a BACK view the attached picture is the new outfit from the front: show the same character from directly behind, same pose, every color the same as the front. Clean, simple 3D cartoon toy style exactly like the attached picture: every area one smooth, flat, solid color, with no texture at all - no fabric grain, no knit, no stitching, no plaid, no dirt, no folds or wrinkles painted on, no shading or shadows painted on, nothing see-through and nothing glowing. Small details as simple solid shapes, close to the body - nothing thin or long sticking out (no feathers, no stalks, no straps hanging loose). No logos, brand marks, emblems, swooshes, stripes on shoes, printed words, letters, numbers or graphics. Not like any famous character from a film, cartoon or game. Full body standing in an A-pose: arms straight and angled clearly down and away from the body with a clear gap between each arm and the body all the way down, hands open, legs slightly apart, feet flat. Centered and filling the whole height, nothing cropped. Plain flat light-gray background, even soft light, no floor shadow. One character only, no text.
instructions: Run all eight rows sequentially in listed order.
Attach only the listed reference; FRONT uses the original approved character, BACK uses the FRONT saved immediately before it.
Inspect each reference before generation. Inspect and save each generated result before advancing.
Every prompt includes the entire Picture Standard and the exact Picture row.
Create output folders as needed; do not overwrite existing artwork without explicit replacement authorization.
